No download, version upgrade or system environment change. These dependency wheel archives are temporary validation inputs, not release artifacts.

private_path_scan_review.reviewed_text: New adapter docs, examples and public phase3 reports/evidence contain no /Users/, /home/ or /private/var/folders absolute paths.

limitations: The exact serial-native continuous correctness gate remains false (12/13 matches in each historical policy process); this package check does not rerun, relax or supersede it.
Experimental candidate only, not a release, release approval or performance claim.

Two example configs are included in sdist and fixed source, not wheel under the existing wheel package configuration. CLI/API metadata smoke used the fixed-source repo example; runtime wheel does not require those files.
Only CPU packaging/import/metadata/API checks executed here; no inference, model downloads or GPU activity.

Site build initially used host python3 without itertools.pairwise; rerunning with required Python 3.12 succeeded. Initial offline resolver attempt found a cached cp313 PyYAML wheel; corrected compatible-tag cache selection, with no install made by the failed attempt.

For example-based custom registration, wheel-only users must obtain the two configs from the matching source commit or sdist; relative examples/models paths do not exist merely from pip installing this wheel.
